title: Dualizing exchange rectangles and compatible sections
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A, four compactifiable quasi-compact maps between Noetherian schemes, with the original map separated and locally of finite type, two Cartesian factorizations of one scheme rectangle give the same specified dualizing exchange after the pullback square comparison. Given compatible sections and dualizing isomorphisms, restriction of an inverse dualizing exchange commutes with the section comparison whenever their rectangle commutes. All maps are the actual counit mates and derived pullback composition/section isomorphisms.

proof.text: Apply dualizing base-change composition in both factorizations of the rectangle. Replace the equal outer arrows by dependent equality elimination and cancel the common pullback compositor.

Pull the commuting rectangle along the new section. Naturality and the derived section-composition equation move the inverse exchange past the section pullbacks. Cancel the adjacent inverse comparisons.
